reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/filename.rs returns allocated quoted/path strings and readfd xbuffer data; open_altfile can also transfer a popen FILE and its FD through caller output slots. Those outputs are different resource owners.
owner_creation.invariant: A returned filename allocation is distinct from a retained process stream.
limitations: An FD obtained with fileno borrows its FILE rather than duplicating it.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/filename.rs quotes through raw input and environment escape pointers while constructing independent output bytes. open_altfile stores a FILE and fileno FD together, so closing the stream invalidates that FD view.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Input/escape borrows and transferred pipe aliases need matched lifetimes.
limitations: Pointer types do not encode whether a returned value is borrowed or newly allocated.

callback_targets.analysis: src/filename.rs shellcmd invokes popen directly after building shell text and frees temporary quoted command strings after the native call. The returned FILE remains a process-stream owner, not a callback context.
callback_targets.invariant: Native command execution must not retain caller temporary string storage.
limitations: The source call signature alone does not certify all native ABI assumptions.

invalidation.analysis: src/filename.rs pclose consumes pipe streams on empty/error outcomes; successful pipe mode instead publishes pfd/pf and returns a new saved dash-name. The caller must distinguish those ownership outcomes.
invalidation.invariant: A consumed FILE must not remain a live descriptor alias.
limitations: No atomic owner aggregate enforces agreement between pfd, pf and returned name.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/filename.rs computes quoting and shell command sizes with wrapping additions, then writes native strings into allocated storage. Separate length, pointer and output-slot writes require caller and arithmetic invariants.
mutation_commit.invariant: Allocated capacity must cover every encoded output byte and NUL.
limitations: No new overflow or capacity failure is reproduced by this source review.

release_pair.analysis: src/filename.rs frees shellcmd scratch strings after popen, frees quoted close-command inputs after formatting and pclose consumes the child stream. Returned readfd data is intentionally transferred to its caller.
release_pair.invariant: Transferred strings require caller free; process streams require pclose.
limitations: freeing a fileno integer is never a substitute for the FILE counterpart.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/filename.rs close_altfile frees the first quoted filename if quoting the second fails, and shellcmd returns null on failed command quoting. Other partial construction paths rely on fatal allocator handling.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure cleanup must follow only owners already acquired on that branch.
limitations: No whole-module failure-transaction guarantee is inferred from these local exits.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/filename.rs retains raw environment and active-input relationships while allocating strings and handing off child streams. M0-MEM-001 remains open; the file registers no exclusion or deferred mutation protocol.
signals_handoff.invariant: Path and pipe owner mutation belongs to ordinary serialized execution.
limitations: This packet establishes no specific asynchronous call route into filename expansion.
